findings.description: Low-contrast light grey text (category column cells, table headers, 'Signed in as' line) is well below WCAG 4.5:1 on white/light background.
Edit/Delete controls are identical for every row with no accessible name identifying the expense, so screen reader users cannot tell them apart.

notes: Only brief pass; layout at 360 and 1280 had no overflow.

cost.notes: estimate from 16184 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0032-$0.0388
